description: Compact golden corpus for the formal verification proof tactician (FVT-G020 / FVT-004). Defines solvable, mutated, impossible, ambiguous, unsupported, and unavailable recipes that measure end-goal formalization, proof-gap recovery, proof-chain authority, counterexample replay/minimization, and honest failure across the twelve required scenario families. Fixtures bind licenses, provenance, and expected authority ceilings. They never embed private witnesses, raw source/stdout, credentials, or tokens, and never label offline expected results as live verification.
conflict_policy: Own new corpus contracts and fixtures; do not tune production behavior to fixture strings or label injected expected results as live verification.
